description:
Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Staff of Domination, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
